notes: Portrait, from slightly below and to the left, a wooden street bookcase ('Boekentil', Hever, Belgium) with a glass front reflecting the sky and houses, taken outdoors in daylight at low resolution (1227 px wide); the white 'Boekentil' lettering on the glass covers the lower half of the top shelf. Dutch with two English paperbacks. Two shelves: on the top, De zeven zussen face-out (labelled once, also as a spine beside it), Two Caravans and Coupe banale as spines; on the bottom, Dodelijke omhelzing face-out and seven spines. Left out: the teal spine at the far left of the top shelf ('Dua ...', too small), the white script spine at the top right ('...stof op de wind', first word hidden by the glass reflection), the pink book at the right of the bottom shelf ('Man man! ...', partly hidden by a wooden strut) and the purple children's book beside Grote kleine leugens (no readable title). The Jackie Collins cover shows a woman's legs; no faces. Non-book items: a price sticker on De zeven zussen, the bookcase sign, houses and a hedge. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 109), verified by an agent.
